name: GolemHarvest
note: Harvest golem (Westfall; CreatureModelData 71, displays 71/367/378/379/514/548/1150). The native model is missing from the data, so there is no template; creature/golemharvest/golemharvest.m2 (FileDataID 124235, byte-identical in Forever and Retail) is the classic geometry. Its BLPs are offline in the local Forever client (CascLib 4350), so the recipe reads Retail. Displays use HarvestGolemSkin<Color> (type 11, variation 0) and HarvestGolemBits<Color> (type 12, variation 1).
